package.name: Clipboard
package.author: Peersus contributors
package.description: Clipboard text sharing with explicit permissions and optional automatic synchronization.

capabilities.clipboard.use: Read clipboard text for explicit sharing or separately enabled automatic synchronization, and replace this device's clipboard with text from an authorized paired device. Android excludes sensitive local clips; desktop clipboard APIs may not expose sensitivity metadata.

exports.description: Shares clipboard text between this computer and a paired device.

share.description: Reads the clipboard text and sends it to the device you chose.

receive.description: Takes text a paired device sent and puts it on the clipboard, replacing what is there.

settings.label: Automatically synchronize clipboard text
settings.help: Opt in here and per device. Android sends new copies when you return to this app and can receive with background connectivity enabled. Pre-opt-in and sensitive clips are excluded.

settings.label: Automatically send clipboard text to this device
settings.help: Requires automatic synchronization, the clipboard permission and the send permission for this device. Incoming text also requires this plugin's per-device clipboard permission.
